remarks: COUNTRY LIVING IN THE CITY!  This almost one acre lot has been cleared and meticulously maintained for the past 5 years!  And with 100 of frontage, this lot is perfect to build your dream home or use for recreation!  Work done includes professional tree company cutting down approximately 50 dead ash trees and removing the wood; stump removal; removing poison ivy, brush, rocks, and fixing ruts; added many large truckloads of soil to half the lot and then area was graded and seeded; after soil settled, added more topsoil and did final grade and seed.  Property is now mostly lawn with oak and other trees and abuts to acres and acres of woods all the way to Roby Street.
